name: deutsch-atlas
//workspaces: The learner app is the root package and stays there: Astro requires its content collections to live under the project root, and content/ is shared with the editorial app, so it belongs at the repo root and the app has to meet it. Moving the app to apps/lernen and pointing `root` back at the repo was tried on 2026-08-14 — collections resolved, then the build failed in "Rearranging server assets" on every MDX outside the root that imports a component, and redirecting `root` produced a build with zero pages. apps/* holds the tools that are not the product; packages/* holds what both consume.
//undeclared-until-2026-08-14: @typescript-eslint/parser and vite are used by this repo and were never declared — they resolved only because Bun hoisted Astro's and typescript-eslint's copies to the top level. Declaring workspaces switches the linker to isolated and both surfaced at once. The parser one had teeth: without it astro-eslint-parser cannot read a .astro frontmatter at all, so every .astro file would have failed with `Parsing error: The keyword 'interface' is reserved` — an entire surface silently unlinted. vite is a direct `import type { Connect }` in src/integrations/progress-writer.ts; keep its range in step with Astro's. sharp is the third and was the one with real teeth: it appeared ONLY under overrides — a version floor for Astro's optional copy, never a declaration — so once hoisting stopped, `bun run build` died in `generating optimized images` with MissingSharp. It cleared validate, test, check and lint on the way there, because nothing else in the repo touches an image, and it reproduces only on a platform where the copy was not hoisted (green on macOS, red on ubuntu-latest). Astro's default image service needs it; declare it, do not rely on being lent one.
//overrides: Security floors only. Each version already satisfies its parent's declared range (astro: sharp ^0.34.0 || ^0.35.0, svgo ^4.0.1; ajv: fast-uri ^3.0.1) — the pin just stops the resolver settling below the patched release. Drop an entry once its parents' own floors clear it; `bun audit` is the check.
